svg.title: Coax potential, radial field and cumulative field energy: a=1 mm, b=4 mm, V=1 V; c=2 mm for layers
svg.desc: Actual inputs: a=1 mm, b=4 mm, V=1 V; c=2 mm for layers. Blue solid: uniform epsilon_r=4. Orange dashed: layers epsilon_r=2 / 8. Each horizontal axis is radius in mm. E jumps at c; phi and cumulative energy remain continuous.
svg.text: a=1 mm, b=4 mm, V=1 V; c=2 mm for layers
Ideal static BVP; curves are generated from its equations, not measurements.
